topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can’t believe this is happening. I mean, I know what they're saying, but it feels so off, you know? It’s just, this entire situation doesn’t fit with the person I’ve known for years. Plagiarism? Really? I just keep thinking about all the times we’ve sat together, stressed over papers, going over every detail to make sure everything was right. It’s hard to see them standing there, defending something that doesn’t even seem like it could be true. I wish there was a clear answer, something that made all of this just disappear. But I’m here, and I’m going to be here, no matter what people say. We’ll figure this out, we always do.
